document: GroundedReview Controlled Evidence Experiment (CEE) - frozen offline design
status: DESIGN FROZEN - OFFLINE ONLY; no paid API call has been made; execution blocked pending written approval

research_questions.primary: When two models receive byte-identical, already-complete evidence, do they make the same supportable decision? This isolates Evidence Interpretation from Evidence Acquisition / Verification Policy.
research_questions.construct_1_evidence_interpretation: Given the SAME fixed evidence bundle (no tools, no escalation, single turn), can the model correctly ACCEPT on sufficient positive evidence, REJECT on decisive negative evidence, and abstain (NEED_EVIDENCE) only when evidence is insufficient?
research_questions.construct_2_acquisition_policy: Not measured by CEE. In E1, whether the agent chooses to obtain sufficient evidence (tool calls, escalation) was entangled with interpretation. CEE removes acquisition by construction so that E1-vs-CEE contrast speaks to the policy contribution.

arm_specification.turns: single request per cell; no server; no function-calling loop
arm_specification.evidence: one canonical fixed Evidence Bundle rendered per fixture; both providers receive byte-identical bundle body bytes inside an item-invariant prompt head

sampling.max_tokens_completion_cap: see cee_plan.json (fixed identical cap for both providers)

arm_specification.cells: 22 fixtures x 2 models = 44 independent single-turn requests; exactly one request per cell, no retries on valid HTTP 200 (parse failures are scored INVALID, not retried)

sample_set.selection_rule: the FULL frozen 22-fixture paired set (phase2 5 + phase3 4 + wave2 13), in frozen wave2_gold order
sample_set.no_post_hoc_selection: no fixture, bundle, or prompt was selected, dropped, or tuned using any model output or observed E1 error; the sample is fixed ex ante to results

class_definition.sufficient_positive: frozen oracle_gold == ACCEPT: linked, fresh, complete, executed, failure-free acceptance evidence and issue symptom gone
class_definition.decisive_negative: frozen oracle_gold == REJECT: either (linked AND fresh AND executed acceptance failure) OR issue symptom still reproduces on the target patch (diagnostic channel P), the latter decisive even when the served artifact is unlinked/stale
class_definition.insufficient: frozen oracle_gold == NEED_EVIDENCE: no decisive negative and intact positive success not established

gold_treatment.rule: frozen Wave-2 dual-channel oracle rule (evidence/gold_w2.py:oracle_gold), re-derived independently in cee_protocol.derive_cee_gold_row from recomputed signed-record facts + symptom polarity

channels.acceptance_O: executed f2p/p2p outcomes of the signed served record; applicability requires linked AND fresh; ACCEPT additionally requires complete, >0 executed checks, zero failures
channels.diagnostic_P: issue-derived symptom probe; symptom present before and still reproduces after the patch is an applicable decisive failure bound to the issue, independent of artifact linkage

gold_treatment.identity_assertion: all 22 independently derived cee_gold rows equal the frozen wave2_gold oracle_gold (build aborts otherwise); also equal to frozen condition_gold['T3A-T'] for all 22 rows (full-information arm)
gold_treatment.primary_metric_anchor: CEE primary scoring uses cee_gold == oracle semantics only
gold_treatment.dual_metric_discipline: E1 Oracle DA and Condition DA remain E1 constructs. CEE does NOT recompute a condition-projected gold (there is no restricted surface: every adjudication in the bundle is presented). CEE scores and E1 scores are NEVER pooled or averaged across protocols; they may only be contrasted mechanistically.

provider_neutral_contract.constraint_mode: json_schema strict on BOTH providers (no json_object downgrade for either model)
rules: additionalProperties = false at the object root
all fields typed; decision enum exactly ACCEPT/REJECT/NEED_EVIDENCE; evidence_gap enum includes the empty string option for non-abstain decisions
the SAME canonical schema object bytes are sent to both providers
provider_neutral_contract.purpose_p1: removes the E1 format confound where DeepSeek used strict schema and GPT used json_object; both CEE arms use the identical legal strict schema

decision_scoring.parse: frozen evidence.ternary.parse_ternary_decision classifies each response as a clean ternary decision, AMBIGUOUS (multiple candidates), or INVALID; unparseable output is a scored failure, never silently retried

labels.false_commit_accept: gold NEED_EVIDENCE or REJECT & decision ACCEPT (unsupported acceptance; reported separately for gold=NEED vs gold=REJECT)
labels.over_abstain: gold ACCEPT or REJECT & decision NEED_EVIDENCE (reported separately for the two gold classes)
labels.unsupported_reject: gold ACCEPT or NEED_EVIDENCE & decision REJECT (premature rejection; reported separately for the two gold classes)

decision_scoring.stratified_reporting: Decision Appropriateness and every error label reported overall AND within each of sufficient_positive / decisive_negative / insufficient, with parseable and all-requests denominators shown separately

statistical_plan.unit: fixture cell; clustering unit = instance_id (independent GitHub issue), 10 clusters
statistical_plan.per_model: DA overall and per evidence class (parseable denominator), plus always-NEED baseline rate for reference; error-type counts
statistical_plan.paired_comparison: per-cell paired indicator (model appropriate or not) keyed by bundle_id; between-model Delta with issue-cluster nonparametric bootstrap CI (seed=7, n_boot=10000, resample issues with all their cells), mirroring evidence/ev1_paired._cluster_bootstrap; descriptive exact McNemar on discordant cells, explicitly flagged low-power with small discordant n
statistical_plan.cluster_bootstrap_for_class_rates: class-stratified rates also carry cluster bootstrap CIs where the class cells span >=2 clusters; otherwise exact cell proportion only
statistical_plan.multiplicity: exploratory single primary contrast (overall DA Delta); class/error-type breakdowns are descriptive, no p-value claims
statistical_plan.power_caveat: 22 cells / 10 issue clusters and class sizes 7/6/9 are small; all CEE language is preliminary/exploratory, CIs are expected to be wide and may cross zero; CEE is a mechanism-isolation study, not a population-frequency estimate
statistical_plan.decision_rule: no binary significance gate; interpretation: convergence under fixed bundles vs divergence in E1 implicates acquisition/policy; persistent divergence under identical bundles implicates interpretation

relationship_to_e1.status: CEE is a separate, sixth protocol alongside the five frozen E1 conditions; it reuses fixtures and evidence, never E1 responses
contrast_logic: if models converge on CEE bundles but diverged in E1: E1 gap is primarily attributable to Evidence Acquisition / Verification Policy (tool/escalation choices)
if models still diverge on identical bundles: a component is attributable to Evidence Interpretation / calibration
error-type shift (over-abstention vs unsupported acceptance) is compared at the label level, never by pooling DA numbers
forbidden: pooling or averaging CEE and E1 DA

execution_gate.current_phase: offline design + bundle build + selftest + budget plan only
execution_gate.required_to_unblock: explicit written approval of cee_plan.json hard budget cap; runner requires an explicit --allow-paid-run flag (default refuses)
